content: Ŋwa' wvun saŋ me wvù Jɛm, waa lemme Nyo' bô Tata Jisos Klistu. Me nsaŋ fô dikfuu di bonyii bo Nyo' le di yuufe ncow difɛɛ dì nu ɛ tawse woŋ e tfuu. Me ŋgayte ben e.
Keelese fitele yî Nyo' le noo keefeefene
Boom bo bwɛɛm e, ɛ́ mmom too fô ben e jé le jé le, ɛ́ ben jo lɛ ɛ̀ nu bvujoŋkɛ.
Me njemyi nonɛn njefo no ben fele ɛ̂ mmom ɛnte, leese kɛ fitele yî Nyo' le, nu ɛ yí nu ege ɛ́ ben ekee keekuu shém ntay.
Ben ekuulè kɛ shém nonɛn egɛn emɛse, wvu lɛ ben enu bonyii bò nu ɛ taw ɛ kocɛn, yaa tane fiɛɛ yî yene le kɛ.
Ɛ́ wee mvu ben e tane bvufee keekiɛɛ fiɛɛ fì Nyo' gomte, ɛ́ wvú lɛkɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛ̂ Nyo' ɛ́ wvú enya. Nyo' nu wvù nyaa ɛ̂ wee tfuu bô fitele ficii yaa waale wee kɛ.
Geenɛn, wee edioo elɛke no leeme kɛ bô Nyo' fitele fimwaaŋ, yaa maŋene kɛ. Ben ekeè lɛ wee wvù maŋene nu diɛwɛ joo yi baay yì fwefwe bvuyte ɛ yí shɛɛŋke bii jò wvú gɛne.
Fo wee diɛwɛ wvuwɛ le ekpwaakè lɛ wen nu ke elɛkɛ fiɛɛ ɛ̂ Nyo' ekɛŋkɛ kɛ.
Wvuwɛ wee nu wvù kɛŋke mvuntelem mvunfɛɛm, tuwtene lo yî fiɛɛ ficii fì wvú gee le.
Bonyii bo kefufe le bô bo kpwaw e
Wee mbee wvù fuute eyuukè njoŋ lɛ Nyo' nu ɛ bense wase wvú,
ɛ́ wee kpwaw eyuukè njoŋ lɛ bó nu ɛ shike wase wvú, njefo wvú nu ke egɛn ecinɛ kpwaw we le kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ no fow ké looke yî ɛgay e ke nɛ yɛlɛ.
No diuu ké sane dioo baa ton'yi ɛ ɛgay yowlɛn, ɛ fow wvù yî dvú le yɛlɛ, ɛ bvujoŋkɛ bwew ka, nu kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ no wee wvù ghane kuŋene kpwaw we nu ke egɛn.
Mmom bô mwɛɛm mvù teeyi bonyii

Njoŋ wvu baay nu wvu wee wvù kuule shém seke mmom ɛ to fô wvú le, njefo ɛ̀ nu seke wvú ɛ leem ɛ tɛme, ɛ́ wvú ke ekɛŋkɛ kefo ke bvunfon e kè ɛ̀ nu nshii wvù mɛy lo kè Nyo' nu ɛ kaw wee tfuu wvù kooŋke wvú dvú.
Fo fiɛɛ ké dioo teeyi wee lɛ wvú ege kebefɛ, ɛ wvú no duù lɛ ɛ̀ teeyi Nyo' wen kɛ, njefo kɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ fiɛɛ etelɛ Nyo' lɛ wvú ege kebefɛ kɛ. Ɛ kɛ Nyo' ké no teeyi fiew wee kɛ.
Fiɛɛ fì ké telɛ wee nonɛn, nu mwɛɛm mvù befe mvù wvú kɛŋke shiee yî dvú le, ɛ́ mvú dioo ɛ lɛwcɛ wvú mum wow,
ɛ́ shiee wvun ké tɛme, mum to bô kebefɛ, ɛ́ kebefɛ ké dioo ɛ ku ɛ kocɛn, to bô kpwe.
Boom bo bwɛɛm e bò nu shém yɛm, fo ben elɛɛlè bikuu binɛn kɛ.
Mwɛɛm mvunciim mvù jee nu lɛŋ, mvù beene kɛŋke nɛn'yi ɛ ɛ̀ nu fowe fô Nyo' le. Ɛ̀ nu wvú Cee Mbom mwɛɛm mvunciim mvu fowe mvù nyaa n'yuu. Kɛ Nyo' kumene diɛwɛ kenjiŋjiŋ e kè ké no kumene mondvuum kɛ.
Ɛ̀ nu wvú wvù to cawɛɛ beene nya beene bô diɛw yì nu kecɛɛy ɛ yí nya nshii wvu fwɛ ɛ̂ beene, wvu lɛ beene enù fiɛɛ fi fwe fì wvú to balɛɛ lɛ ɛ̀ nu naa fiew ɛnte jo mwɛɛm mvunciim mvù wvú to bomɛɛ.
Keeyuuke diɛw Nyo' gee no yí gomte
Boom bo bwɛɛm e bò nu shém yɛm, ben ekiɛɛ lɛ wee tfuu kɛŋke keenu cekey keenya bitem yî fiɛɛ le, joò wɛɛ bô njeme, joò wɛɛ bô shém yì ton'yɛɛn,
njefo kɛ wee wvù ton'yi shém nulo ege fiɛɛ fi teytey fì Nyo' shieele kɛ.
Fí ɛ no nu lɛ, ben ecinɛ nce nnyɛn e noo keŋge kè tɛmyi le, eshike bikuu binɛn, efiisɛn diɛw Nyo' yì Nyo' nu ɛ lese fô mvuntelem mvunɛn e. Diɛw yin nu yì nulo eboyse ben.
Fo ben elɛɛlè bikuu binɛn keeyuuke kɛ lo diɛw Nyo' maaŋ kɛ. Ben egeè no yí gayte.
Wee wvù yuuke kɛ lo diɛw Nyo' yaa gee no yí gayte, nu diɛwɛ wee wvù nu ɛ taa bvushiw bwew ɛ̂ kenlɛɛy e,
no wvú tale nonɛn, ɛ base jim ɛ mum ɛ kase ɛ daayɛ no nfieesɛn ye nu.

Geenɛn, wee wvù looci taale ɛ̂ nci wvù taashi bonci bocii bvuu bvuuse bonyii bvunfaw e, leeme yî dvú le sekecii, yaa daayi fiɛɛ fì wvú yuuke ɛ wvú jemyi, gee no wvú gayte, nu ɛ Nyo' nu ke elaŋ kembonɛn yî fiɛɛ ficii fì wvú gee le.
Ɛ́ wee teŋe ɛkolɛ kew lɛ wen looci nu wee mbee, ɛ faŋɛ yaa ejici leme diew e, tu wvú lɛɛle ɛkolɛ kew, ɛ fiɛɛ fì wvú teŋe ɛkolɛ kew lɛ wen nu wee mbee nu ɛcici.

Mbee wvù Nyo' Icee wesebeene yɛne ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvu lɛŋ bvuu yuule ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise, nu wvu wee wvù taale fô boom bo boŋkfu le noo fô bokɛ' bo boŋkfu le seke bó nu yî ŋgɛw e. Ɛ ɛ̀ bvuu nu tɛn wvù kemsene bô ɛkolɛ kew fo mwɛɛm mvu yî nshɛ le fɛn elom wvú.

footnotes.text: Dikfuu di bonyii bo Nyo' le nu Bojuu bò nu ɛ lese fitele yî Jisos Klistu le, ɛ bó ɛ tawse ɛ no cee bitum bimew e.
